T.YouTube title: I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud by William Wordsworth | Classic Poetry Reading
T.YouTube description:
"I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud" by William Wordsworth.

Wordsworth wrote it in 1804, two years after he and his sister Dorothy came upon a long belt of daffodils by Ullswater in the Lake District. It was first published in 1807; he added the second stanza in 1815, and this reading uses the longer version. A crowd of daffodils, seen once on a walk, keeps coming back to the poet long afterwards.
